title: Retail Inventory Event-Driven Scaling
business: E-commerce retailers managing fluctuating inventory update requests.
problem: Traditional monolithic services struggle to scale granularly during sudden traffic spikes, leading to resource waste during idle periods.
solution: Azure Container Apps enables serverless container execution with event-driven scaling, allowing individual microservices to scale based on incoming request volume or queue depth.
steps: Package the inventory microservice as a container image and push it to a container registry.
Create an Azure Container Apps environment to host the microservice.
Define scaling rules based on HTTP traffic or event triggers like queue length.
Deploy the container image to a new revision within the app environment.
outcome: Improved resource efficiency by automatically scaling down to zero when no events are present and scaling out rapidly during high-demand periods.
limitation: Cold starts may occur when scaling from zero, which can be verified by monitoring request latency during initial traffic bursts after an idle period.
